tunnel_250: Setting: a round running tunnel of the Moscow metro north of VDNKh station, about 5.5 m across, ribbed concrete lining stained black with soot and seepage, bundles of old cables along both walls, two rusty rails on rotten wooden sleepers. A distance number '250' is painted on the wall and a black-and-white striped post stands by the track. The outpost is a small campfire between the rails with wooden crates as seats around it. Beyond the circle of firelight the tunnel falls into total darkness in both directions.
peregon_savelovskaya: Setting: a running tunnel of the Moscow metro towards Savyolovskaya station, round ribbed concrete lining, cables along the walls, two rails on wooden sleepers, a makeshift barricade about 1.5 m high across the track built from sleepers, scrap and sandbags. No lamps; only the light the people carry, everything beyond it is pitch black.
north_cordon: Setting: the north cordon of VDNKh, a fortified post in a cast-iron segmented metro tunnel: bolted iron ring segments, sandbag walls across the track, a heavy searchlight on a stand throwing a hard white beam down the tunnel, crates of ammunition. Outside the beam the tunnel is black.
vdnkh: Setting: VDNKh metro station in 2033 turned into a settlement: a long pylon hall with arches between massive marble pylons; worn army tents pitched inside the arches, plywood shacks along the outer walls, laundry hanging on lines, a tea stall behind a low partition with steam and smoke, a red digital clock above the tunnel mouth at the end of the hall. Light comes from bare dim bulbs on cables and small fires; the vaults above stay in shadow.
botanical: Setting: Botanical Garden metro station, sixteen years ago, abandoned and dark: dusty pylon hall, the foot of a long escalator shaft with stopped escalators, broken balustrades and exposed gear wheels in the gaps, a steel control lever by the escalator landing. No station lights; only the lantern the people carry.
botanical_vestibule: Setting: the surface vestibule of Botanical Garden station: a round hall under a concrete half-dome, broken glass openings with the grey sky of a dead city outside, debris and dust on the floor.
sukhoi_tent: Setting: inside the army tent of Sukhoi, Artyom's stepfather, at VDNKh station: canvas walls, shelves made of open wooden crates packed with old books, a camp bed, a table, a single bare bulb hanging on a cord from the ridge. Through the door flap the station outside glows faint red.
timiryazevskaya: Setting: Timiryazevskaya metro station, half-ruined and almost dark: dusty pylon hall, a breach in the west wall opening into blackness, scattered debris on the platform.
vdnkh_office: Setting: the station administration office at VDNKh: a cramped room in the station's service rooms, a heavy old desk with papers, a wall map of the metro, a single desk lamp, concrete walls.
white_room: Setting: a vision, not a real place: an endless seamless white room with soft even light from everywhere, no shadows, no visible walls or edges.
